EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 894 April 22, 1983
Subject Matter : Modifying EO No. 860 setting side for the Consumer Price Equalization Fund ( EF) the
additional 3% ad valorem duty collected on crude oil and finished petroleum product imports.
Date of Effectivity : April 22, 1983
